g.title: crate These headless interactions combine bindings and owner lifetimes.
crate::calendar A calendar grid behavior attaches month, week, day and month-paging parts.
crate::calendar::handle The `CalendarGrid` handle: grid, rows, paging buttons and day cells.
crate::calendar::policy The selection and the policy a calendar grid is created with.
crate::calendar::state Calendar state shares the shown months, the selection and the day registry.
crate::combobox A combobox filters keyed options by a query and tracks one active option.
crate::dialog Dialog attaches modal, alert, drawer and popover surface semantics.
crate::disclosure Disclosure attaches an expandable trigger and its optionally delayed content.
crate::drag Owner-scoped pointer drag sessions attached to sources as parts.
crate::edit Edit sessions: the start, commit and cancel of one continuous edit.
crate::focus_return One target and reason policy for returning focus when a surface closes.
crate::list One list behavior attaches selection and navigation through parts.
crate::list::data Passive list inputs, policies and observable item state.
crate::list::handle The `List` handle: setup options, reads, selection commands and parts.
crate::list::input List input enters the shared selection and navigation state.
crate::list::order Logical list order normalizes keys and chooses enabled destinations.
crate::list::parts List parts bind and unregister exact mounted focus targets.
crate::list::selection Selection transitions preserve caller order and hidden selections.
crate::list::state List state shares one registry, selection writer and focus authority.
crate::list::typeahead Type-to-find navigation for menus and lists.
crate::menu Application menus with nesting and typeahead.
crate::menu::handle The `MenuApi` handle: open state, triggers, content, items and submenus.
crate::menu::level The levels of an open menu: rows, focus, keys and pointer.
crate::menu::order Pure menu lookup and retained-level ordering helpers.
crate::menu::session Menu session operations coordinate opening, focus and closing.
crate::menu::state Store menu entries and shared session state.
crate::menubar A menu bar moves the open menu among a row of menu triggers.
crate::palette A command palette joins a modal dialog and a combobox over commands.
crate::policy Pure policies supporting owner-aware interaction controllers.
crate::policy::grid Two-dimensional grid moves from keys, independent of a UI runtime.
crate::policy::scalar Validated scalar bounds and optional quantization, independent of a UI runtime.
crate::popup Popup adds overlay focus, dismissal and restoration to a disclosure.
crate::range_scalar Two thumbs editing the ends of one range without crossing.
crate::roving Roving focus registry shared by list, table and menu levels.
crate::scalar Binding-backed scalar operations and semantic control parts.
crate::scalar::edit_state Edit session, drag and focus count shared by the thumbs of one scalar.
crate::scalar::handle The `Scalar` handle: binding writes, key steps, assistive actions and its parts.
crate::scalar::range The ranges a scalar accepts, and the write-back when one leaves the value out.
crate::scalar::track Map the pointer along a slider's track to the value of a thumb.
crate::sealed Public-in-bounds traits that only this crate can name or implement.
crate::select A select attaches a combo box trigger and its list box to caller nodes.
crate::splitter Unstyled behavior and semantics of a splitter between two panes.
crate::table A table behavior attaches grid, header, row, cell and resize parts.
crate::table::cells Cell-focus rows and cells move a roving tab stop with grid keys.
crate::table::data Passive table inputs, the focus pattern and observable part state.
crate::table::handle The `Table` handle: options, sort, widths, and its grid, row and cell parts.
crate::table::model A headless row model: filter, sort and page the caller's rows by column.
crate::table::state Table state shares the row list, sort, widths and the cell registry.
crate::tabs Tabs attach keyed semantics and navigation to caller-owned elements.
crate::text_edit Headless native text editing over the public primitive contracts.
crate::text_edit::handle The `TextEdit` handle: native editing options and the control part.
crate::text_edit::policy Pure native editing keys and clipboard normalization.
crate::toaster Toast notifications with dismissal control.
crate::toggle Button, check box, switch and toggle button semantics without appearance.
crate::tone The meaning of a status, a notification or a message, as plain data.
crate::tooltip Tooltip attaches a delayed hover and focus hint, one shown per App.
crate::tree Tree navigation with expansion and selection.
crate::zoom_pan Shared view transforms and owner-scoped zoom and pan input.
